profile.subtitleJa: シリア南西部の古代都市。
profile.summaryJa: シリア南西部の都市で、使徒言行録ではサウロが向かった町として登場します。本文は当時の都市の具体的な境界を示さないため、現代市域と古代都市域は同一視できません。
profile.modernLocationJa: シリア南西部、バラダー川のオアシスに位置する現在のダマスカス周辺。古代市域の厳密な境界は特定しない。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 使徒言行録9章2節で、サウロがエルサレムの諸会堂に宛てた手紙を携えて向かおうとした町。
profile.locationNoteJa: 割当候補座標だけでは根拠にできない。今回の作業では該当地名のPleiades固定データまたは考古学機関資料を個別確認できていないため座標はnull。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.
Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.
“As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.
I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’
When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
“Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,
but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.
